title: Order-poset path-feature SOS lower bound
objective: Project the exact path-square representation of E[(MM^T)^-1] onto a finite path-feature space so that Bessel or SOS positivity gives a computable Loewner lower bound.
acceptance_checks: All path-union probabilities are derived as linear-extension counts divided by factorials.
Truncation is performed before expanding the square or otherwise preserves PSD order.
Cases q=2,3,4 are compared to the Jensen and resolvent corrections.
No absolute-value bound is accepted if it destroys the target constant.
